# Three.js vendor files

Version: 0.186.0 (r186). Source: official `three` npm package, fetched with
`npm pack three@0.186.0`. The files `build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`
and `LICENSE` were copied without modification. MIT license; see `LICENSE`.

The module build imports the adjacent core build. Both must remain together.
Documentation: https://threejs.org/docs/pages/ShaderMaterial.html
